verdict.rationale: A probe confirms an llms.txt (HTTP 200) on Cloudflare's developer documentation site, which hosts the MoQ Relay docs, so an agent can be pointed at it. However, the per-page markdown version of the MoQ docs returns 404, and nothing shows the llms.txt actually indexes MoQ content. Missing for 10: confirmation that llms.txt covers MoQ Relay pages, a working markdown/agent-oriented version of the MoQ docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
